3. Watch online tutorials: There are many free origami tutorials available online. Look for step-by-step videos that show you how to fold specific origami models. Some popular websites with origami tutorials include YouTube, OrigamiUSA, and Instructables.

5. Join an origami group or club: Connecting with other origami enthusiasts can be motivating and help you learn new techniques. Look for local origami groups or clubs, or join online forums and communities.

6. Experiment with different materials: Origami can be done with a variety of materials, including colored paper, tissue paper, and even fabric. Experiment with different materials to create unique origami projects.
